beats.summary: Toby announces he will take a leave of absence to serve as a juror on a high-profile criminal case.

evidence.snippet: Toby: Uh, I just wanted to let you know that, uh, I'll be taking a leave of absence starting next week.

beats.summary: Michael and others mock Toby about the case and joke about the Scranton Strangler.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Yes, the case of the horrible red-headed sad sack. And the verdict, it was Toby. And the sentence, death. Death to Toby!

beats.summary: Toby reveals Holly Flax from the Nashua branch will temporarily replace him.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Hold on, Holly's coming back here?

beats.summary: Michael cancels the current Christmas party to prepare a new one for Holly's return, insisting on fresh food and a bigger celebration.

evidence.snippet:
Pam: Before we kick off the party, I just want to remind everyone that an office party is just that…
Michael: Yeah!
Pam: A party. It's not an excuse to get really drunk or confront someone or have a cathartic experience of any kind.
Michael
